mapper.select: select CMFUSERID as cmfUserId, SECID as secId, QRCODEURL as qrCodeUrl, TO_CHAR(INSERTTIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS insertTime FROM USER_CODE_INFO WHERE SECID=#{secId}
mapper.insert: insert into USER_CODE_INFO ( CMFUSERID , SECID , QRCODEURL , INSERTTIME ) values( #{qrCode.cmfUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{qrCode.secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{qrCode.qrCodeUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
